description: Output JSON written by gauntlet/tools/run_triceratops.py after driving TRICERATOPS (Giacalone et al. 2021). value is the headline FPP. metrics preserves the full per-scenario breakdown (never reduced to a bare pass/fail) plus the degenerate flag: a degenerate computation reports FPP=1.0 for a failed computation, not a confident false positive, and the adapter maps it to UNMEASURED. A completed run must carry numeric FPP/NFPP (if/then below).

artifacts.description: Evidence file paths — the per-scenario probability table CSV when completed.

config_hash.description: sha256 of the tool config file, echoed from the input.

input_hashes.description: Input hashes echoed from the input JSON (lightcurve + neighbours), so a cached result is verifiable.

contrast_curve_used.description: True when a high-resolution-imaging contrast curve constrained the neighbour scenarios; without one NFPP is an upper bound.

dilution_corrected.description: Whether the input light curve was already dilution-corrected (SPOC/TESS-SPOC PDCSAP: true; QLP KSPSAP: false). Recorded so the record says what was assumed.

fpp.description: False positive probability (1 - planet probability). Null unless completed.

fpp_degenerate.description: True when every MC draw was geometrically invalid (all scenario log-evidences -inf): FPP=1.0 then reflects a failed computation, not a confident false positive.

most_likely_false_positive.description: Highest-probability non-planet scenario, e.g. 'EB on TIC 423498315'. Null unless completed.

n_fold_points.description: Number of phase-folded cadences inside the ±3-duration window that were binned (~200 bins) for calc_probs (P-15). Null when the run failed before binning.

n_samples.description: Monte Carlo draws used (N in calc_probs); 0 when the computation never completed.

nfpp.description: Nearby false positive probability. Null unless completed.

phase_seconds.description: Wall seconds per tool phase (target_init: MAST TIC cone + Gaia background + per-sector TessCut fetch; calc_depths; calc_probs). Null when the run failed before the tool phases began; partial when a phase never started.

prob_eb_neighbour.description: Summed probability of EB/BEB scenarios on a resolved nearby star. Null unless completed.

prob_eb_target.description: Summed probability of EB scenarios on the target star. Null unless completed.

prob_hierarchical_eb.description: Summed probability of EB scenarios on a bound companion (PEB/SEB). Null unless completed.

prob_planet.description: Planet probability (1 - FPP, from the tool's own FPP). Null unless completed.

n_transits.description: Transits the signal rests on, echoed from the input.

seed.description: Seed echoed from the input (np.random.seed before calc_probs — TRICERATOPS has no seed parameter).

status.description: Tool outcome: completed (FPP/NFPP computed), failed, or timeout.

tool_version.description: Installed triceratops version (importlib.metadata), falling back to the input's expected version with a warning.

value.description: The headline FPP when completed, else null.

wall_time_s.description: Wall time of the TRICERATOPS invocation, seconds.

title: TRICERATOPS tool output (Phase 2, 2C)
